description: Write a whole number (up to trillions, negatives allowed) out in English words, e.g. for cheques and invoices. Also returns the cheque form with 'and' cents when given a decimal amount. Use when amounts must be written out in full. Example: number=1234.5. Price $0.003/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only; not marked read-only because each call is charged.
name: number_words
